slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 26 Jun 2026
ON Semiconductor announced a $7 billion all-stock acquisition of Synaptics.
This move is expected to expand ON Semiconductor's edge AI capabilities.
The acquisition is valued at $7 billion.
This is one of the largest acquisitions in the edge AI market.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The acquisition will enable ON Semiconductor to strengthen its position in the edge AI market.
It will also provide the company with access to Synaptics' advanced technologies.
The deal is expected to close in the coming months.
Source: Intellectia AI, 26 Jun 2026

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 28 Jun 2026
The Nasdaq Weekly Review showed a 4.6% decline in the tech-heavy index.
This is the worst week for the index since spring.
The decline was driven by doubts over AI spending and the delay of OpenAI's IPO.
The index fell by 4.6% in just one week.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The decline in the Nasdaq index is a significant indicator of the market's sentiment towards tech stocks.
The delay of OpenAI's IPO has raised concerns over the company's valuation and the overall AI market.
The decline in the index may have a ripple effect on the entire tech industry.
Investors are closely watching the market for any signs of recovery.
